title: Home — Content

fields.message: Home — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_home_hero_sub
fields.instructions: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write & and — as literal characters.
fields.default_value: From a classic Board & Brew sandwich to a slice at Odie's — we're here for the moments that matter.

fields.label: Yellow tagline
fields.name: brg_home_hero_tagline
fields.instructions: The short line beneath the sub, in the display face. White, not yellow, per the comp. ~40 characters.
fields.default_value: Good food. Real people. Rad experience.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_home_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe — keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback with no skewed edge to overhang. u1 scaleX bar, the lab's baseline, kept so the taper argument can be re-checked live. Unknown or blank renders the mark STATIC and visible, never hidden. u2/u4 (dasharray draws) need the artwork inline as SVG and are not available on an . Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Intro — before the emphasis
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_1
fields.instructions: Opening clause, up to the colon. The space before the bold phrase is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
fields.default_value: Blacktop Restaurant Group started with a simple belief:

fields.label: Intro — bold phrase
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_emphasis
fields.instructions: Rendered bold, mid-sentence. A clause, not a paragraph.
fields.default_value: that a great meal is really just an excuse to connect.

fields.label: Intro — after the emphasis
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_2
fields.instructions: The rest of the paragraph. Carries the founding year, so it needs editing if that is ever restated.
fields.default_value: Since 2013, we've been growing a family of restaurant brands rooted in genuine hospitality, craft food, and a deep love for the communities we call home.

fields.label: Body copy — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_community_body_1
fields.instructions: Plain text; markup is escaped. Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: We're not a corporation chasing locations — we're operators who eat at our own restaurants, know our guests by name, and measure success by how many times someone walks out the door smiling.

fields.label: Body copy — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_community_body_2
fields.instructions: Carries the live location counts, so it needs editing whenever they change — which is the main reason it is a field. Write & and — as literal characters. CROSS-SECTION FACT — this number also appears in our-restaurants-brands -> Board & Brew second paragraph, and community-stats -> Stat 1 figure. Going ACF-editable REMOVED the check that used to catch a mismatch: it was three greppable strings in the repo, and it is now three database rows that nothing repo-side can compare. If you change one, change all three. (doc strings are per-field by construction, so this warning has to be repeated in each — there is nowhere on this project that can hold a cross-section fact.)
fields.default_value: Today, BRG operates 12 Board & Brew locations across San Diego and Orange County, plus Odie's Pizza Co. in Oceanside — and we're just getting started.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_home_about_heading
fields.instructions: Sits above the vision/mission pair, in the display face. ~24 characters.

fields.label: Vision — label
fields.name: brg_home_about_vision_label
fields.instructions: The small caps label above the vision statement.

fields.label: Vision — statement
fields.name: brg_home_about_vision_text
fields.instructions: Display face, large. Short — it is a slogan, not a paragraph.

fields.label: Mission — label
fields.name: brg_home_about_mission_label
fields.instructions: The small caps label above the mission statement.

fields.label: Mission — statement
fields.name: brg_home_about_mission_text
fields.instructions: Display face, large. One sentence; past ~90 characters it starts to unbalance the column against the photo.
fields.default_value: To amp up our communities by creating real connections and rad experiences.

fields.label: A different kind of restaurant company
Body copy — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_different_body_1
fields.default_value: The restaurant industry has a reputation: long hours, high turnover, burnt-out teams. We're working to change that.

fields.label: Body copy — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_different_body_2
fields.instructions: Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: We believe the best guest experiences start with the best team experiences. When our people feel valued, supported, and genuinely stoked to come to work — that energy is contagious. You feel it the moment you walk in.

fields.label: Body copy — third paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_different_body_3
fields.instructions: Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: We're building something that lasts — not just great food, but great careers, great communities, and a model that proves you can do right by your people and run a great business at the same time.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_home_values_heading
fields.instructions: Sits above the values grid, in the display face. Plain — no marker block, no line break. ~24 characters.

description: Editable content for the Home page, one tab per section. Generated — edit website/sections/<id>/slots.json and rerun kit/build-acf.py.
